_doc: REACT (WHO REACT Working Group, JAMA 2021, PMID 34228774, PMC8261689) Figure 1, tocilizumab: per-trial 28-day deaths/randomised, read from the figure image. SECONDARY and the COMPARATOR: never a source for matching REACT (anti-circularity); used only as the target a primary row is compared with.

governing.label: tocilizumab vs usual care or placebo, fixed-effect log OR
governing.why_not_held: PMC full text is free to read but not under an open licence (pmc-prop-open-access no); the publisher does not allow XML download
governing.quote: In 19 trials that randomized 4299 patients to tocilizumab (960 deaths) and 3749 patients to usual care or placebo (1023 deaths), the summary OR was 0.83 (95% CI, 0.74-0.92; P < .001).

drug_k.quote: The IL-6 antagonists assessed were tocilizumab (19 trials allocating 4299 patients to tocilizumab and 3749 patients to usual care or placebo)

stated_counts.reading: 27 is REACT's IL-6-antagonist class count; the tocilizumab-specific count, our target, is 19. The trial count is stated, not unstated.
stated_counts.reported_by: external review of the tocilizumab-covid19-mortality topic (28 Sep 2026)

row_notes.quote: All trials supplied data until 28 days after randomization, except for the PreToVid trial for which data are based on events up until 30 days after randomization.
row_notes.reading: REACT's PreToVid row is day-30 mortality; a strict day-28 review must not inherit it.

IMMCoVA's own paper is from 2023 (PMID 38157348, NCT04412291); REACT's 2021 prospective meta-analysis already analysed it, so the paper does not make it a new trial: membership is by trial identity, never by date.

caption.quote: The area of the data marker for each trial is proportional to its weight in the fixed-effects meta-analysis.
caption.why_not_held: PMC page free to read, no open licence

figure.why_not_held: JAMA figure, PMC8261689: free to read, no open licence
